feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: The path to treating multiple-etiology dementia: Combining vascular risk control and disease-modifying neurodegenerative therapies.
drug.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the A
drug.zh: 多病因痴呆需血管危险控制与抗淀粉样蛋白等神经退行性疗法联合，单通路治疗已不足。

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效及ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下注射仑卡奈单抗可作为阿尔茨海默病起始治疗，疗效与静脉给药相当。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样治疗需权衡脑淀粉样血管病等脑血管病患者的卒中诊疗与ARIA风险。

drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂红碳点通过氢键和范德华力结合溶菌酶非催化口袋，抑制其淀粉样纤维化。

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本受访者对lecanemab的最小可接受获益高于其实际绝对获益，该期望-疗效差距需转化为抗淀粉样蛋白诊疗路径中的具体临床任务。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-突触核蛋白与Tau免疫疗法虽临床失败，但其表位选择、生物标志物分层、混合病理及神经炎症四大教训为阿尔茨海默病联合免疫策略指明方向。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样治疗获益与风险受脑和全身衰弱调控，衰弱应纳入AD治疗决策框架。

mech.title: Associations between serum estradiol and estrone and Alzheimer's disease biomarkers: An analysis in female participants from the European Prevention of Alzheimer's Dementia Longitudinal Cohort Study (EPAD LCS).
mech.zh: 在EPAD队列绝经后女性中，血清雌二醇和雌酮与脑脊液Aβ42、pTau181、tTau等AD生物标志物无显著关联。

mech.title: TogoPhosTAC as a delivery-ready platform for targeted protein dephosphorylation.
mech.zh: TogoPhosTAC借脂质纳米粒递送预组装复合物或mRNA，实现EGFR、α-突触核蛋白与tau的靶向去磷酸化。

mech.title: Peripheral-central inflammatory crosstalk in Alzheimer's disease: immunometabolic functions of circulating soluble metabolites under dynamic blood-brain barrier states.
mech.zh: 循环可溶性代谢物在血脑屏障动态变化下经免疫代谢途径介导AD外周—中枢炎症交互。

mech.title: Integrative analysis of single-cell multi-omics reveals heterogeneity in piriform cortex principal neurons and their selective vulnerability in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 单细胞多组学揭示梨状皮层主神经元四种亚型，其中Reln+浅层亚型选择性易损且与Aβ病理空间相关。

mech.title: Cellular transcriptomic signatures underpinning the heterogeneity of depression in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病合并抑郁的异质性源于特定脑细胞类型的转录组改变，而非单一共享分子通路。

mech.title: Estrogen deprivation exacerbates Alzheimer's disease pathology through neuronal CTSS signaling.
mech.zh: 雌激素缺失通过神经元CTSS信号加剧Aβ病理、神经炎症和认知障碍，而阻断雌激素受体可重现此效应。

mech.title: Abortive transcripts in exosomes - A potential biomarker for Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 外泌体中8核苷酸流产转录本可无创反映AD脑内转录失调，Bace1、Tyrobp和Pf4来源者显著升高，具血液标志物潜力。

mech.title: Design, synthesis and multitarget evaluation of cyclopropyl-appended thiohydantoin derivatives as dual cholinesterase and COX inhibitors with antioxidant activity: a combined experimental and computational study.
mech.zh: 环丙基硫代乙内酰脲S-烷基化衍生物可同时抑制胆碱酯酶与COX并具抗氧化活性，为阿尔茨海默病多靶点治疗提供新候选。

dx.title: Real-world anti-amyloid therapy beyond traditional symptomatic populations: a longitudinal case series.
dx.zh: 真实世界三例抗淀粉样蛋白治疗显示，临床轨迹因生物标志物谱和治疗阶段而异。

dx.title: Evidence for similar enzymatic but different cellular generation of pE79-modified α-synuclein in PD and AD mouse models.
dx.zh: pE79-αSyn在PD与AD小鼠模型中酶促生成机制相似，但细胞定位不同。

dx.title: Chronic kidney disease and cognitive decline: choroid plexus remodeling, glymphatic dysfunction, and alzheimer biomarker interpretation.
dx.zh: 慢性肾病通过脉络丛重塑和类淋巴功能障碍驱动认知衰退，并干扰阿尔茨海默病生物标志物判读。

dx.title: Expression differences and diagnostic efficacy of core plasma biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, cerebral small vessel disease and healthy adults.
dx.zh: 血浆p-Tau217和GFAP在AD与CSVD及健康人间差异显著，对AD诊断及两者鉴别效能最优。

dx.title: Sociodemographic and clinical characteristics of participants in blood p-tau217 studies for Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review.
dx.zh: 血p-tau217诊断AD的研究人群多集中于记忆门诊和高度选择样本，社会人口学与临床特征报告不足，代表性存疑。

dx.title: Neuroimaging in the era of biologically defined Alzheimer's disease and disease-modifying therapy.
dx.zh: 生物标志物与淀粉样蛋白PET正重塑阿尔茨海默病诊断，影像学成为治疗资格判定与疗效监测的核心。

dx.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
dx.zh: 基于Aβ42/40与p-tau217的专家混合模型血检算法可高效富集临床前AD试验的淀粉样蛋白PET阳性受试者。

dx.title: Alterations of gut microbiota in Down syndrome and their association with Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 唐氏综合征成人肠道菌群组成改变与阿尔茨海默病血液标志物及认知衰退相关。

prev.title: Health-related factors and their impact on blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 可调控的健康因素（如体力活动、睡眠、肾功能和血脂）会显著影响阿尔茨海默病血浆生物标志物水平，解读时需加以校正。

prev.title: Effects of hearing intervention on blood-based biomarkers of neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration: a secondary analysis of the ACHIEVE randomised controlled trial.
prev.zh: ACHIEVE试验二次分析显示，听力干预未显著减缓3年内血浆GFAP和NfL的变化。

prev.title: Associations between serum estradiol and estrone and Alzheimer's disease biomarkers: An analysis in female participants from the European Prevention of Alzheimer's Dementia Longitudinal Cohort Study (EPAD LCS).
prev.zh: 绝经后女性血清雌二醇与雌酮水平越高，脑脊液Aβ42、pTau181及tTau病理负荷越轻。

prev.title: Alterations in varicella-zoster virus immunity around dementia diagnosis in older adults.
prev.zh: 痴呆确诊前后水痘-带状疱疹病毒IgM/IgG抗体动态变化提示其免疫失调与发病相关。

prev.title: Operational definitions of type 2 diabetes influence study population characteristics and outcome associations: Empirical evidence from the UK Biobank.
prev.zh: 不同2型糖尿病操作定义会改变UK Biobank研究人群构成及与死亡、心梗、卒中和痴呆的关联强度。

prev.title: Characterization of a metabolomics signature of the brain-health-promoting MIND diet in older persons.
prev.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's
prev.zh: 血清代谢组学特征可有效区分MIND饮食依从性并预测老年人认知下降风险。

prev.title: Exploring TIMP2 genetics and CSF levels in Parkinson's disease: biomarkers of neurodegeneration and ageing.
prev.zh: 帕金森病脑脊液TIMP2升高与神经退行性变及衰老相关，但与GBA1突变状态无关。

prev.title: Real-world anti-amyloid therapy beyond traditional symptomatic populations: a longitudinal case series.
prev.zh: 真实世界三例抗淀粉样蛋白治疗显示，临床轨迹因生物标志物谱与治疗时机而异。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血查几个指标就能提前挑出可能得老年痴呆的人，帮研究新药的试验少走弯路、更快找到合适的人。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，护好血糖、管住代谢，也许就能帮大脑少受伤害。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治阿尔茨海默病的新药虽能清脑内斑块，却可能让脑血管变脆、引发脑水肿或微出血，这篇综述提醒普通人：有中风风险的人用前得格外小心。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里造出迷你大脑，专门研究大脑里的“保安细胞”怎么在老年痴呆中帮倒忙，帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是抽血查阿尔茨海默病的新方法，比腰穿和脑扫描更便宜、更方便，有望让普通人早发现早治疗。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的“清洁工”细胞一旦失控会加速老年痴呆，这篇综述教我们怎么把它们拉回正轨来治病。

intro.title: Brain organoids in Alzheimer disease and related tauopathies: Challenges and opportunities for translational readiness.
intro.zh: 科学家正想办法用迷你人脑试药来替代总失败的小鼠实验，好让阿尔茨海默病新药更快更准地研发出来。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期失眠可能是预防老年痴呆的一个可改窗口，帮女性护脑。
